text:
Rina (AE): Cedarworks POC approved. Procurement emailed PO with redlines: want customer-managed KMS, 99.99% SLA for POC, and countersign-first. Need quick alignment.
Hannah (Finance): They requested NET60 and a $6k credit on the POC. Standard is NET30; NET60 needs approvals.
Rina (AE): Billing contact is billing@cedarworks.co — please confirm remit name. They included a PO template.
Caleb (Legal): I reviewed redlines. We can accept KMS attestation (ARN + test encrypt) but not third-party key custody. 99.99% for a POC is too strict; propose 99.9% with credits capped to POC fees.
Nora (Security): Need SOC2 report and pen test summary. For KMS validation, request a one-time encrypt-and-return test. We can provide the CLI snippet.
Marcus (SRE): Provisioning requires signed order form + PO + KMS attestation. If KMS provided, allow 48h for IAM mapping. Estimated 4 business days to provision after paperwork.
Hannah (Finance): Concession ticket opened for promotional credit. I'll escalate NET60 to RevOps but advise they change to NET30 to speed setup.
Rina (AE): They insist legal sign first. We prefer controlling DocuSign order. Can Legal propose signing order that preserves audit trail?
Caleb (Legal): Yes — propose DocuSign order: 1) Cedarworks AE (ack PO) 2) Cedarworks Legal 3) Redwood Legal. We'll ask for envelope with explicit final sign for Redwood.
esign-bot: Draft envelope created (order form link).
Marcus (SRE): KMS validation snippet to send to customer: ```aws kms encrypt --key-id <KMS_ARN> --plaintext "rw-validation" --output text```
Rina (AE): Action list: @Caleb draft reply accepting KMS attestation + 99.9% POC SLA; @Hannah confirm credit approval; @Marcus post onboarding checklist. I'll hold provisioning until DocuSign complete.
Cedarworks (external): Thanks team, we'll return PO and KMS ARN by EOD tomorrow.
Rina (AE): Thanks — I'll consolidate and email procurement. :thumbsup:
